uk.B: Оскільки ми знаємо страх Господній, ми намагаємося переконувати людей. Бог уже ясно бачить, які ми є, і я сподіваюся, що ваші сумління бачать нас так само ясно.
uk.R: Ми знаємо, як сильно треба шанувати Господа й боятися {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, тому ми намагаємося привернути людей. Бог знає нас цілком. І я сподіваюся, що глибоко в душі ви теж знаєте, які ми люди.

ja.L: それで、主への恐れを知っているので、わたしたちは人々を説得しています。しかし、神には、わたしたちは明らかにされています。そして、あなたがたの良心にも明らかにされていることを、わたしは望んでいます。
ja.B: わたしたちは主を恐れるとはどういうことかを知っているので、人々を説得しようと努めています。神は、わたしたちがどういう者であるかを、すでにはっきりと見ておられます。あなたがたの良心にも、同じようにはっきりと見えていることを、わたしは願っています。
ja.R: わたしたちは、主がどれほど敬い恐れるべき方であるかを知っています。だから、人々に信じてもらおうと努めているのです。神は、わたしたちのことをすっかり知っておられます。みなさんも、心の奥で、わたしたちがどんな者であるかを知っていてくれたらと願っています。

decisions.choice: the fear of the Lord: reverent awe before Christ, who will judge
alternatives: the fear people feel toward Paul
decisions.reason: τὸν φόβον τοῦ κυρίου looks back to the judgment seat of Christ (verse 10). It is the reverence owed to the Lord that the Old Testament calls the beginning of wisdom (Proverbs 1:7), held by one who will give account to him.

decisions.choice: we persuade people: we try to win them, to the gospel and to trust in our honesty
decisions.reason: πείθομεν can mean to win people over to the faith (Acts 18:4, of Paul in Corinth) or to convince them of one's sincerity. The next words, and verse 12, show that Paul has his own honesty in view as well as the message he preaches.

decisions.choice: made known: already seen through, laid open
decisions.reason: πεφανερώμεθα is the perfect of the verb in verse 10: what all will be at the judgment seat, Paul already is before God. He hopes the Corinthians' consciences will see him as plainly (4:2).

decisions.choice: I hope: Paul speaks for himself
decisions.reason: ἐλπίζω is singular. The shift from "we" shows that in this passage the "we" is mainly Paul himself (compare 1:8).

decisions.choice: set out to persuade; sees us clearly for what we are
decisions.reason: "Set out" shows that persuading is their ongoing work; "sees us clearly" says what being made known to God means (m3).

decisions.choice: how much the Lord is to be respected and feared; deep inside you know what kind of people we are
alternatives: the fear of the Lord; to be made known in your consciences
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the fear of the Lord" (m1) and what being made known in their consciences means (m3).

decisions.choice: {{gender:a las personas|a los hombres}}
decisions.reason: As in the English Literal, the traditional "los hombres" is offered as the alternative for the Greek word that means people in general.

decisions.choice: kumcha Bwana
decisions.reason: As in Romans 3:18, Swahili has a verb for reverent fear, "kumcha", which says the meaning decision's awe without the sense of being frightened that "hofu" carries. "Watu" needs no gender span where the English Literal offers "men".

decisions.choice: "người ta", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Người ta" already means people in general.

decisions.choice: ሰዎችን, with no gender span
decisions.reason: ሰዎች, 'people', is already inclusive in Amharic, so the English Literal's gender setting has nothing to change here.

decisions.choice: "मनुष्यों को" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a span on "men". "मनुष्य" already means a human being, woman or man, so there is nothing for a setting to change (style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: людей, without a setting
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a gender setting here; Russian "люди" already means women and men, so no span is needed.

decisions.choice: людей (no gender span)
decisions.reason: The Greek means human beings, and Ukrainian "люди" is already inclusive, so the English span has no Ukrainian counterpart.

decisions.choice: "人々" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span with "男たち" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The English needs a gender span on "people"; Japanese "人々" already includes men and women, so no span is needed (style guide 7a).

source.text: οὐ πάλιν ἑαυτοὺς συνιστάνομεν ὑμῖν, ἀλλὰ ἀφορμὴν διδόντες ὑμῖν καυχήματος ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν, ἵνα ἔχητε πρὸς τοὺς ἐν προσώπῳ καυχωμένους καὶ μὴ ἐν καρδίᾳ.

records.literal_gloss: Not again ourselves we commend to you, but an occasion giving to you of boasting on behalf of us, so that you may have [it] toward the [ones] in face boasting and not in heart.

en.L: We are not commending ourselves to you again, but giving you an occasion for boasting on our behalf, so that you may have [an answer] for those who boast in [the] face and not in [the] heart.
en.B: We are not recommending ourselves to you again. Rather, we are giving you a reason to be proud of us, so that you will have something to say to those who take pride in outward show and not in what is in the heart.
en.R: We are not trying to make you think well of us all over again. We are giving you a reason to be proud of us. Then you will have an answer for people who brag about how things look on the outside but do not care what is in the heart.

fr.L: Nous ne nous recommandons pas de nouveau nous-mêmes auprès de vous, mais [nous vous] donnons une occasion de vous vanter à notre sujet, afin que vous ayez [de quoi répondre] à ceux qui se vantent de l’apparence et non du cœur.
fr.B: Nous ne nous recommandons pas de nouveau à vous. Nous vous donnons plutôt une raison d’être fiers de nous, pour que vous ayez quelque chose à répondre à ceux qui tirent leur fierté des apparences, et non de ce qui est dans le cœur.
fr.R: Nous n’essayons pas de nouveau de vous faire penser du bien de nous. Nous vous donnons une raison d’être fiers de nous. Alors vous aurez une réponse pour les gens qui se vantent de ce qui se voit de l’extérieur, mais qui ne se soucient pas de ce qui est dans le cœur.

es.L: No nos recomendamos otra vez a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, sino que {{plural_you:les|os}} damos ocasión de {{plural_you:gloriarse|gloriaros}} de nosotros, para que {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} [qué responder] a los que se glorían en [la] apariencia y no en [el] corazón.
es.B: No volvemos a recomendarnos a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Más bien {{plural_you:les|os}} damos un motivo para estar orgullosos de nosotros, para que {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} algo que decir a los que se enorgullecen de las apariencias y no de lo que hay en el corazón.
es.R: No estamos tratando de que {{plural_you:piensen|penséis}} bien de nosotros otra vez. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} damos una razón para estar orgullosos de nosotros. Así {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} una respuesta para la gente que presume de cómo se ven las cosas por fuera, pero no le importa lo que hay en el corazón.

sw.L: Hatujitambulishi tena kwenu, bali tunawapa nafasi ya fahari kwa ajili yetu, ili mpate [la kujibu] kwa wale wanaojivunia uso wala si moyo.
sw.B: Hatujitambulishi kwenu tena. Badala yake, tunawapa sababu ya kuona fahari juu yetu, ili mpate la kuwajibu wale wanaoona fahari katika sura ya nje wala si katika yaliyo moyoni.
sw.R: Hatujaribu tena kuwafanya mtufikirie vizuri. Tunawapa sababu ya kuona fahari juu yetu. Ndipo mtakuwa na jibu kwa watu wanaojigamba kwa jinsi mambo yanavyoonekana kwa nje, lakini hawajali yaliyo moyoni.

vi.L: Chúng tôi không tự giới thiệu mình với anh chị em một lần nữa, nhưng cho anh chị em cơ hội để khoe mình về chúng tôi, để anh chị em có [lời đáp] cho những người khoe mình về bề ngoài chứ không về tấm lòng.
vi.B: Chúng tôi không tự giới thiệu mình với anh chị em một lần nữa. Trái lại, chúng tôi cho anh chị em lý do để tự hào về chúng tôi, để anh chị em có điều để nói với những người tự hào về vẻ bề ngoài chứ không về những gì trong lòng.
vi.R: Chúng tôi không cố làm cho anh chị em nghĩ tốt về chúng tôi một lần nữa. Chúng tôi đang cho anh chị em một lý do để tự hào về chúng tôi. Khi đó anh chị em sẽ có câu trả lời cho những người khoe khoang về vẻ bên ngoài mà không quan tâm đến những gì ở trong lòng.

ko.L: 우리가 다시 여러분에게 우리 자신을 추천하는 것이 아니라, 여러분에게 우리를 위해 자랑할 기회를 주려는 것입니다. 마음이 아니라 겉모양을 자랑하는 사람들에게 [대답할 것을] 여러분이 가지게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 우리는 다시 여러분에게 우리 자신을 추천하려는 것이 아닙니다. 오히려 여러분이 우리를 자랑스럽게 여길 수 있는 근거를 주려는 것입니다. 그래서 마음속에 있는 것이 아니라 겉모습을 자랑하는 사람들에게 여러분이 대답할 수 있게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.R: 우리는 또다시 여러분이 우리를 좋게 생각하게 하려는 것이 아닙니다. 우리는 여러분이 우리를 자랑스럽게 여길 이유를 주고 있습니다. 그러면 여러분은 마음속은 생각하지 않고 겉으로 보이는 것을 뽐내는 사람들에게 대답할 수 있을 것입니다.

pt.L: Não estamos nos recomendando outra vez a vocês, mas dando a vocês ocasião de se gloriarem a nosso respeito, para que tenham [o que responder] aos que se gloriam na aparência e não no coração.
pt.B: Não estamos nos recomendando outra vez a vocês. Pelo contrário, estamos lhes dando um motivo de orgulho a nosso respeito, para que tenham o que dizer aos que se orgulham das aparências e não do que está no coração.
pt.R: Não estamos tentando fazer vocês pensarem bem de nós outra vez. Estamos dando a vocês um motivo para terem orgulho de nós. Assim vocês vão ter uma resposta para as pessoas que se gabam da aparência das coisas, mas não se importam com o que está no coração.

am.L: ራሳችንን እንደ ገና ለእናንተ አናስተዋውቅም፤ ነገር ግን በልብ ሳይሆን በፊት ለሚመኩ [መልስ] እንዲኖራችሁ ስለ እኛ የምትመኩበትን ምክንያት እንሰጣችኋለን።
am.B: ራሳችንን እንደ ገና ለእናንተ ማስተዋወቃችን አይደለም። ይልቁንም በልብ ባለው ሳይሆን በውጫዊ ገጽታ ለሚኮሩ ሰዎች የምትመልሱት እንዲኖራችሁ፣ በእኛ የምትኮሩበትን ምክንያት እንሰጣችኋለን።
am.R: ስለ እኛ በጎ እንድታስቡ እንደ ገና መሞከራችን አይደለም። በእኛ የምትኮሩበትን ምክንያት እየሰጠናችሁ ነው። ከዚያም በልብ ውስጥ ያለውን ሳይሆን ከውጭ የሚታየውን ብቻ ለሚኩራሩ ሰዎች መልስ ይኖራችኋል።

hi.L: हम फिर से अपनी सिफ़ारिश तुमसे नहीं करते, पर तुम्हें अपने विषय में गर्व करने का अवसर देते हैं, ताकि तुम्हारे पास उनके लिए [उत्तर] हो जो मुख पर गर्व करते हैं, न कि हृदय पर।
hi.B: हम फिर से तुम्हारे सामने अपनी सिफ़ारिश नहीं कर रहे। बल्कि हम तुम्हें हम पर गर्व करने का कारण दे रहे हैं, ताकि तुम्हारे पास उन लोगों से कहने के लिए कुछ हो जो बाहरी दिखावे पर गर्व करते हैं, न कि उस पर जो हृदय में है।
hi.R: हम फिर से यह कोशिश नहीं कर रहे कि तुम हमारे बारे में अच्छा सोचो। हम तुम्हें हम पर गर्व करने का कारण दे रहे हैं। तब तुम्हारे पास उन लोगों के लिए उत्तर होगा जो बाहर से दिखनेवाली बातों पर डींग मारते हैं, पर इस बात की परवाह नहीं करते कि दिल में क्या है।

ru.L: Мы не снова представляем себя вам, но даём вам повод для похвалы нами, чтобы вы имели [что сказать] тем, кто хвалится лицом, а не сердцем.
ru.B: Мы не рекомендуем себя вам снова. Напротив, мы даём вам повод хвалиться нами, чтобы у вас было что ответить тем, кто хвалится внешним, а не тем, что в сердце.
ru.R: Мы не пытаемся снова сделать так, чтобы вы думали о нас хорошо. Мы даём вам причину гордиться нами. Тогда вам будет что ответить тем, кто хвастается тем, как всё выглядит снаружи, а о том, что в сердце, не заботится.

uk.L: Ми не рекомендуємо себе вам знову, але даємо вам привід хвалитися нами, щоб ви мали [що відповісти] тим, хто хвалиться обличчям, а не серцем.
uk.B: Ми не рекомендуємо себе вам знову. Навпаки, ми даємо вам привід пишатися нами, щоб вам було що сказати тим, хто пишається зовнішнім виглядом, а не тим, що в серці.
uk.R: Ми не намагаємося знову змусити вас думати про нас добре. Ми даємо вам привід пишатися нами. Тоді ви матимете відповідь для людей, які хизуються тим, як усе виглядає ззовні, але не дбають про те, що в серці.

ja.L: わたしたちは、再びあなたがたに自分自身を推薦しているのではありません。むしろ、わたしたちのことで誇る機会を、あなたがたに与えているのです。それは、心においてではなく顔において誇っている人々に対して、あなたがたが[答えを]持つためです。
ja.B: わたしたちは、またあなたがたに自分を推薦しているのではありません。そうではなく、わたしたちのことを誇りに思う理由を、あなたがたに与えているのです。そうすれば、心の中にあるものではなく、外見を誇っている人々に、あなたがたは答えることができます。
ja.R: わたしたちは、みなさんにもう一度、自分たちのことをよく思ってもらおうとしているのではありません。みなさんが、わたしたちのことを誇りに思えるようにしているのです。そうすれば、外から見える姿を自慢して、心の中のことは気にかけない人たちに、みなさんは答えることができます。

decisions.choice: commending ourselves: recommending ourselves, as with letters of recommendation
decisions.reason: συνιστάνομεν is the verb of 3:1 and 4:2. "Again" answers a charge Paul has met before (3:1): that he was always recommending himself. He is not doing that; he is giving the Corinthians material for their own answer.

decisions.choice: a reason for boasting about us: grounds for proper pride in Paul
decisions.reason: καυχήματος is a ground for pride, as in 1:14, where Paul and the Corinthians are each other's pride. ἀφορμὴν was a starting point or base of operations. Paul gives them a base from which to answer his critics.

decisions.choice: so that you may have: the object is understood, an answer to give
decisions.reason: ἔχητε has no object. The sense is that they will have something to say in reply to those Paul goes on to describe.

decisions.choice: boasting in the face, not in the heart: pride in outward appearance rather than in what is true within
decisions.reason: προσώπῳ means outward appearance here, set against the heart. The contrast recalls 1 Samuel 16:7, where people look on the outward appearance but the Lord looks on the heart. The rivals Paul answers in chapters 10-12 were proud of their letters, speech and visions (10:10; 11:6; 12:1).

decisions.choice: be proud of us; take pride in (B); be proud of us; brag (R)
alternatives: boasting about us; those who boast
decisions.reason: Following the book-wide choice on boasting, Literal keeps "boast", while Balanced and Readable speak of pride. Readable says "brag" for the rivals, whose pride takes credit for outward things.

decisions.choice: recommending
decisions.reason: As in 4:2, "recommend" keeps the link with the letters of recommendation in 3:1 (m1).

decisions.choice: how things look on the outside but do not care what is in the heart
alternatives: in appearance and not in heart
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the contrast of m4.

decisions.choice: se vantent (R)
decisions.reason: Following the book-wide choice on boasting, Readable usually says "être fier"; for the rivals, whose pride takes credit for outward things, it says "se vanter", which in French is always bad, as the English Readable says "brag".

decisions.choice: presume
decisions.reason: Where the pride is taking credit for outward show, Readable uses the everyday "presumir", as the English Readable uses "brag".

decisions.choice: wanaojigamba
decisions.reason: Where the English Readable says "brag", Swahili Readable uses "kujigamba", pride that shows off, kept apart from the proper pride of "kuona fahari" in the same sentence.

decisions.choice: se gloriarem, se gloriam (L); motivo de orgulho, se orgulham (B); terem orgulho, se gabam (R)
decisions.reason: As set for the book at 1:12: Literal "gloriar-se", Balanced and Readable "orgulhar-se". Readable says "se gabam" for the opponents, where the English Readable says "brag": their pride is in outward show (m4).

decisions.choice: መመካት (L); መኩራት (B); መኩራት, መኩራራት (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:12: Literal keeps the boasting word; Balanced says 'take pride'; Readable says 'be proud of us' and, for the outward show of the rivals, መኩራራት, 'to brag, show off', as the English Readable says 'brag'.

decisions.choice: "डींग मारना" for the rivals (R); "गर्व करना" elsewhere
decisions.reason: As in the English Readable, the rivals' pride in show is plain bragging; "गर्व" stays for the Corinthians' proper pride in Paul.

decisions.choice: гордиться (R, of the Corinthians); хвастается (R, of the rivals)
decisions.reason: As in 1:12, Readable says "гордиться" for good pride; for the rivals, whose pride is empty, it says "хвастаться", as the English Readable says "brag".

decisions.choice: хизуватися
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "пишатися" for the proper pride Paul gives them, and says "хизуватися" for the pride in outward show, as the English Readable says "brag".

decisions.choice: "誇る" (L); "誇りに思う", "誇る" (B); "誇りに思う", "自慢する" (R)
alternatives: "自慢する" for both at Balanced
decisions.reason: Japanese "誇り" carries no bad sense, so Balanced can keep the word family that Literal traces, where the English Balanced moves to "be proud" and "take pride". Readable uses "自慢する" for the rivals' pride in outward show, matching the English "brag".

decisions.choice: "推薦する" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The verb is the language of letters of recommendation (m1; the Corinthians terms note keeps "recommend" through the letter); Readable says what it means.

source.text: εἴτε γὰρ ἐξέστημεν, θεῷ· εἴτε σωφρονοῦμεν, ὑμῖν.

records.literal_gloss: Whether for we were out of our mind, [it is] for God; whether we are of sound mind, [it is] for you.

en.L: For if we are out of our mind, [it is] for God; if we are of sound mind, [it is] for you.
en.B: If we are out of our mind, that is for God. If we are sensible, that is for you.
en.R: If we are out of our minds, it is for God. If we are thinking clearly, it is for your good.

fr.L: Car si nous sommes hors de nous, [c’est] pour Dieu ; si nous sommes dans notre bon sens, [c’est] pour vous.
fr.B: Si nous sommes hors de nous, c’est pour Dieu. Si nous sommes raisonnables, c’est pour vous.
fr.R: Si nous sommes hors de nous-mêmes, c’est pour Dieu. Si nous pensons clairement, c’est pour votre bien.

es.L: Porque si estamos fuera de nosotros, [es] para Dios; si estamos en nuestro juicio, [es] para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Si estamos fuera de nosotros, es para Dios. Si somos sensatos, es para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Si parece que hemos perdido la cabeza, es por Dios. Si pensamos con claridad, es para {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} bien.

sw.L: Kwa maana ikiwa tumerukwa na akili, [ni] kwa ajili ya Mungu; ikiwa tuna akili timamu, [ni] kwa ajili yenu.
sw.B: Ikiwa tumerukwa na akili, ni kwa ajili ya Mungu. Ikiwa tuna akili timamu, ni kwa ajili yenu.
sw.R: Ikiwa tumerukwa na akili, ni kwa ajili ya Mungu. Ikiwa tunafikiri sawasawa, ni kwa faida yenu.

vi.L: Vì nếu chúng tôi mất trí, ấy là vì Đức Chúa Trời; nếu chúng tôi tỉnh trí, ấy là vì anh chị em.
vi.B: Nếu chúng tôi mất trí, ấy là vì Đức Chúa Trời. Nếu chúng tôi tỉnh táo, ấy là vì anh chị em.
vi.R: Nếu chúng tôi có vẻ như mất trí, ấy là vì Đức Chúa Trời. Nếu chúng tôi suy nghĩ sáng suốt, ấy là vì lợi ích của anh chị em.

ko.L: 우리가 미쳤다면 하나님을 위한 것이고, 우리가 정신이 온전하다면 여러분을 위한 것입니다.
ko.B: 우리가 정신이 나갔다면 그것은 하나님을 위한 것이고, 우리가 정신이 온전하다면 그것은 여러분을 위한 것입니다.
ko.R: 우리가 정신이 나간 것처럼 보인다면, 그것은 하나님을 위한 것입니다. 우리가 생각이 맑다면, 그것은 여러분에게 유익을 주려는 것입니다.

pt.L: Pois, se estamos fora de nós, [é] para Deus; se estamos em [nosso] juízo, [é] para vocês.
pt.B: Se estamos fora de nós, isso é para Deus. Se estamos em nosso juízo, isso é para vocês.
pt.R: Se estamos fora de nós, é por causa de Deus. Se pensamos com clareza, é para o bem de vocês.

am.L: ከአእምሮአችን ወጥተን ብንሆን ለእግዚአብሔር ነውና፤ ጤናማ አእምሮ ቢኖረን ለእናንተ ነው።
am.B: ከአእምሮአችን የወጣን ብንሆን፣ ይህ ለእግዚአብሔር ነው። ብናስተውል፣ ይህ ለእናንተ ነው።
am.R: አእምሮአችንን የሳትን ብንመስል፣ ይህ ለእግዚአብሔር ነው። በትክክል የምናስብ ብንሆን፣ ይህ ለእናንተ ጥቅም ነው።

hi.L: क्योंकि यदि हम आपे से बाहर हैं, तो परमेश्वर के लिए; यदि हम सुबुद्धि में हैं, तो तुम्हारे लिए।
hi.B: यदि हम आपे से बाहर हैं, तो यह परमेश्वर के लिए है। यदि हम समझदारी से चलते हैं, तो यह तुम्हारे लिए है।
hi.R: यदि हम आपे से बाहर हैं, तो वह परमेश्वर के लिए है। यदि हम साफ़ सोच रहे हैं, तो वह तुम्हारी भलाई के लिए है।

ru.L: Ведь если мы вне себя, [то] для Бога; если в здравом уме, [то] для вас.
ru.B: Если мы вне себя, это для Бога. Если мы рассудительны, это для вас.
ru.R: Если мы будто сошли с ума, это для Бога. Если мы рассуждаем здраво, это для вашего блага.

uk.L: Бо якщо ми з глузду зʼїхали, [то це] для Бога; якщо ми при здоровому розумі, [то це] для вас.
uk.B: Якщо ми втратили розум, то це для Бога. Якщо ми розсудливі, то це для вас.
uk.R: Якщо ми ніби не при собі, то це для Бога. Якщо ми мислимо ясно, то це для вашого добра.

ja.L: というのは、わたしたちが正気を失っているなら、[それは]神のためであり、正気であるなら、あなたがたのためだからです。
ja.B: わたしたちが正気でないとすれば、それは神のためです。分別があるとすれば、それはあなたがたのためです。
ja.R: もし、わたしたちが正気でないように見えるなら、それは神のためです。わたしたちがしっかり考えて話しているなら、それはみなさんのためです。

decisions.choice: out of our mind: beside oneself, either in ecstatic experience of God or in the eyes of critics
alternatives: only madness as others judged it
decisions.reason: ἐξέστημεν means to be beside oneself, out of one's ordinary mind. It may refer to Paul's visions and ecstatic experiences, which he keeps between himself and God (12:1-4; 1 Corinthians 14:18-19). Or it may answer a charge that he was mad: the same verb is used when Jesus's family said he was out of his mind (Mark 3:21), and Festus told Paul that his learning had driven him mad (Acts 26:24). The evidence does not settle which.

decisions.choice: for God, for you: for God's sake and honor, for your benefit
alternatives: to God, to you, as the ones addressed
decisions.reason: The datives θεῷ and ὑμῖν have no verb. Each says whom the state serves: either way, Paul's life is not lived for himself (verse 15).

decisions.choice: of sound mind: sensible, self-controlled
decisions.reason: σωφρονοῦμεν means to be in one's right mind (Mark 5:15) and to think soberly (Romans 12:3). It is set against being beside oneself.

decisions.choice: out of our mind(s)
decisions.reason: The phrase covers both readings of m1, the ecstatic and the accused.

decisions.choice: hors de nous
decisions.reason: As the English "out of our mind": "être hors de soi" can mean the ecstasy of an experience of God or madness in the eyes of critics, and so keeps both readings of m1 open.

decisions.choice: fuera de nosotros (L, B); hemos perdido la cabeza (R)
decisions.reason: "Estar fuera de sí" keeps both readings of the meaning decision, ecstatic experience and what critics said; Readable adds "parece que" because "perder la cabeza" alone would state it as fact.

decisions.choice: tumerukwa na akili
decisions.reason: "Kurukwa na akili" (to be beside oneself) can describe both an overwhelming experience and what critics say of someone, so it keeps both readings the meaning decision leaves open; "wazimu" (madness) would decide for the critics.

decisions.choice: "미치다" (L); "정신이 나가다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision leaves open whether Paul means ecstatic experience of God or what his critics said of him, uncertain and footnoted; Korean says "out of one's mind" without deciding.

decisions.choice: "आपे से बाहर"
decisions.reason: The phrase covers both readings of meaning decision m1: carried away in an experience of God, or mad in the eyes of critics. "पागल" would choose the second.

source.text: ἡ γὰρ ἀγάπη τοῦ Χριστοῦ συνέχει ἡμᾶς, κρίναντας τοῦτο ὅτι εἷς ὑπὲρ πάντων ἀπέθανεν· ἄρα οἱ πάντες ἀπέθανον·

records.literal_gloss: The for love of the Christ grips us, having judged this, that one on behalf of all died; so then the all died;

en.L: For the love of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} grips us, since we have judged this: that one died on behalf of all; so then all died.
en.B: It is the love of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} that drives us on. We have reached this judgment: one has died on behalf of all, and so all have died.
en.R: We do this because {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} loves us, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} love pushes us on. We are sure of this: one person died for everyone, so everyone has died.

fr.L: Car l’amour du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} nous étreint, nous qui avons jugé ceci : un seul est mort pour tous ; donc tous sont morts.
fr.B: C’est l’amour du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} qui nous pousse. Nous en sommes arrivés à cette conclusion : un seul est mort pour tous, et donc tous sont morts.
fr.R: Nous agissons ainsi parce que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} nous aime, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour nous pousse en avant. Nous en sommes sûrs : un seul est mort pour tous les autres, donc tous sont morts.

es.L: Porque el amor del {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} nos apremia, habiendo juzgado esto: que uno murió por todos; por consiguiente, todos murieron.
es.B: Es el amor {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} lo que nos impulsa. Hemos llegado a esta conclusión: uno ha muerto por todos, y por eso todos han muerto.
es.R: Hacemos esto porque {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} nos ama, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor nos impulsa. Estamos seguros de esto: una persona murió por todos, así que todos han muerto.

sw.L: Kwa maana upendo wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} unatushika, kwa kuwa tumefikia uamuzi huu: kwamba mmoja alikufa kwa ajili ya wote; basi wote walikufa;
sw.B: Ni upendo wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} unaotusukuma. Tumefikia uamuzi huu: mmoja amekufa kwa ajili ya wote, na kwa hiyo wote wamekufa.
sw.R: Tunafanya hivi kwa sababu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} anatupenda, na upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} unatusukuma. Tuna uhakika wa jambo hili: mtu mmoja alikufa kwa ajili ya kila mtu, kwa hiyo kila mtu amekufa.

vi.L: Vì tình yêu thương của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} nắm giữ chúng tôi, vì chúng tôi đã xác định điều này: một người đã chết thay cho mọi người, vậy thì mọi người đều đã chết.
vi.B: Chính tình yêu thương của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} thôi thúc chúng tôi. Chúng tôi đã đi đến kết luận này: một Người đã chết thay cho mọi người, vậy thì mọi người đều đã chết.
vi.R: Chúng tôi làm như vậy vì {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} yêu thương chúng tôi, và tình yêu thương của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thôi thúc chúng tôi. Chúng tôi tin chắc điều này: một Người đã chết cho mọi người, vì vậy mọi người đều đã chết.

ko.L: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 사랑이 우리를 붙잡고 있습니다. 우리가 이렇게 판단하기 때문입니다. 곧 한 분이 모든 사람을 위하여 죽으셨으니, 모든 사람이 죽었다는 것입니다.
ko.B: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 사랑이 우리를 강하게 몰아갑니다. 우리는 이렇게 확신하게 되었습니다. 한 분이 모든 사람을 위해 죽으셨으니, 모든 사람이 죽은 것입니다.
ko.R: 우리가 이렇게 하는 것은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 우리를 사랑하시고, 그 사랑이 우리를 앞으로 밀어 주기 때문입니다. 우리는 이것을 확신합니다. 한 분이 모든 사람을 위해 죽으셨으니, 모든 사람이 죽은 것입니다.

pt.L: Pois o amor do {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} nos domina, tendo nós julgado isto: que um morreu por todos; logo, todos morreram.
pt.B: É o amor {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} que nos impulsiona. Chegamos a esta conclusão: um morreu por todos e, portanto, todos morreram.
pt.R: Fazemos isso porque {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} nos ama, e o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor nos impulsiona. Temos certeza disto: uma pessoa morreu por todos, e por isso todos morreram.

am.L: {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ፍቅር ያስገድደናልና፤ ይህንንም ወስነናል፤ አንዱ ለሁሉ ሞተ፤ እንግዲያስ ሁሉ ሞቱ።
am.B: ወደ ፊት የሚገፋፋን {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ፍቅር ነው። ይህንም ቁርጥ አድርገን ተረድተናል፤ አንዱ ስለ ሁሉ ሞቷል፤ ስለዚህም ሁሉ ሞተዋል።
am.R: ይህን የምናደርገው {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ስለሚወደን ነው፤ ፍቅሩም ወደ ፊት ይገፋፋናል። ይህን እርግጠኞች ሆነን እናውቃለን፤ አንድ ሰው ለሁሉ ሞተ፤ ስለዚህ ሁሉም ሞተዋል።

hi.L: क्योंकि मसीह का प्रेम हमें जकड़े रहता है, क्योंकि हमने यह निर्णय कर लिया है कि एक सब के लिए मरे; इसलिए सब मर गए।
hi.B: मसीह का प्रेम ही हमें आगे बढ़ाता है। हम इस निर्णय पर पहुँचे हैं: एक सब के लिए मरे हैं, और इसलिए सब मर गए हैं।
hi.R: हम यह इसलिए करते हैं क्योंकि मसीह हमसे प्रेम करते हैं, और उनका प्रेम हमें आगे धकेलता है। हमें इस बात का पक्का यक़ीन है: एक व्यक्ति सब के लिए मरे, इसलिए सब मर गए।

ru.L: Ведь любовь {{christos:Христа|Мессии}} держит нас, рассудивших так: один умер за всех; значит, все умерли.
ru.B: Это любовь {{christos:Христа|Мессии}} движет нами. Мы пришли к такому выводу: один умер за всех, а значит, умерли все.
ru.R: Мы делаем это, потому что {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} любит нас, и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} любовь побуждает нас. Мы уверены в этом: один человек умер за всех, а значит, все умерли.

uk.L: Бо любов {{christos:Христова|Месії}} тримає нас, коли ми розсудили так: що один помер за всіх; отже, всі померли.
uk.B: Саме любов {{christos:Христова|Месії}} спонукає нас. Ми дійшли такого висновку: один помер за всіх, а отже, всі померли.
uk.R: Ми робимо це, бо {{christos:Христос|Месія}} любить нас, і {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} любов спонукає нас. Ми певні в цьому: одна людина померла за всіх, тож усі померли.

ja.L: というのは、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の愛がわたしたちをとらえているからです。わたしたちはこう判断しました。一人がすべての人のために死なれた。それゆえ、すべての人が死んだのです。
ja.B: {{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の愛が、わたしたちを駆り立てているのです。わたしたちはこう確信するに至りました。一人の方がすべての人のために死なれたのだから、すべての人が死んだのです。
ja.R: わたしたちがこうしているのは、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}がわたしたちを愛してくださっているからです。その愛が、わたしたちを前へと押し出すのです。わたしたちは、このことを確信しています。一人の方が、すべての人のために死なれました。ですから、すべての人が死んだのです。

decisions.choice: the love of Christ: Christ's love for us, shown in his death
decisions.reason: The genitive τοῦ Χριστοῦ can mean the love Christ has or the love given to him. The next words speak of Christ dying for all, and Paul elsewhere speaks of "the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me" (Galatians 2:20; compare Romans 8:35). So Christ's love for them is meant, though such love also calls out love in return.

decisions.choice: grips: holds them fast and presses them on
decisions.reason: συνέχει means to hold together, to hem in or to press hard. Paul uses it in Philippians 1:23 of being hard pressed between two desires. Here Christ's love holds them so firmly that it governs what they do, whether in ecstasy or soberness (verse 13).

decisions.choice: having judged this: a settled conviction reached in the past
decisions.reason: κρίναντας is an aorist participle: a conclusion they came to, most likely when they came to know Christ, and still hold. ὅτι gives its content.

decisions.choice: one died for all, so all died: Christ died as the representative of all, so his death counts as theirs
alternatives: all died spiritually because of sin
all ought to die to themselves
decisions.reason: ὑπὲρ ("on behalf of") means for their benefit and in their place. Because Christ died in place of all, all are included in his death. Paul says the same of believers in Romans 6:3-8: those joined to Christ have died with him to the old life. Verse 15 says what follows.

decisions.choice: the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the Greek article.

decisions.choice: grips (L); drives us on (B); pushes us on (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of being held; Balanced and Readable say what the grip does (m2).

decisions.choice: Christ loves us, and his love pushes us on
alternatives: the love of Christ pushes us on
decisions.reason: Readable makes the meaning of m1 plain: it is Christ's love for them.

decisions.choice: "một người" (L), "một Người" (B, R) for heis, Christ, with "mọi người" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The Greek says only "one"; Balanced and Readable capitalise "Người" to show that Christ is meant, as Vietnamese writes a pronoun for God or Christ; Literal leaves it plain.

decisions.choice: "{{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 우리를 사랑하시고" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the love of Christ as Christ's love for us, footnoted; Literal and Balanced keep the Greek's "the love of Christ", and Readable says whose love it is.

decisions.choice: "한 분" with the honorific for the one who died, through verses 14-15
decisions.reason: The one who died for all is Christ, so Korean uses the honorific noun "분", as Romans 5:17 does.

decisions.choice: "एक सब के लिए मरे" (honorific verb for the one who died)
decisions.reason: The one who died is Christ (meaning decision m4), so the verb takes the honorific form the book uses for him, which also sets him apart from the "all".

decisions.choice: "とらえている" (L); "駆り立てている" (B); "前へと押し出す" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb both holds fast and presses on (m2). Literal keeps the hold; Balanced and Readable bring out the pressing on, as the English does.

source.text: καὶ ὑπὲρ πάντων ἀπέθανεν ἵνα οἱ ζῶντες μηκέτι ἑαυτοῖς ζῶσιν ἀλλὰ τῷ ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν ἀποθανόντι καὶ ἐγερθέντι.

records.literal_gloss: And on behalf of all he died, so that the [ones] living no longer to themselves may live but to the [one] on behalf of them having died and having been raised.

en.L: And on behalf of all {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} died, so that the living may no longer live to themselves but to the one who on their behalf died and was raised.
en.B: He died on behalf of all, so that those who live would no longer live for their own sake, but for the sake of the one who died and was raised on their behalf.
en.R: He died for everyone so that people who are alive will not live just to please themselves anymore. They will live for {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, who died for them and was raised back to life.

fr.L: Et pour tous {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est mort, afin que les vivants ne vivent plus pour eux-mêmes, mais pour celui qui pour eux est mort et a été ressuscité.
fr.B: Il est mort pour tous, afin que ceux qui vivent ne vivent plus pour eux-mêmes, mais pour celui qui est mort et a été ressuscité pour eux.
fr.R: Il est mort pour tous, pour que ceux qui sont vivants ne vivent plus seulement pour se faire plaisir. Ils vivront pour le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, qui est mort pour eux et qui a été ramené à la vie.

es.L: Y por todos murió, para que los que viven ya no vivan para sí mismos, sino para el que murió y resucitó por ellos.
es.B: Él murió por todos, para que los que viven ya no vivan para sí mismos, sino para aquel que murió y resucitó por ellos.
es.R: Él murió por todos para que la gente que está viva ya no viva solo para agradarse a sí misma. Vivirán {{christos:para Cristo|para el Mesías}}, que murió por ellos y volvió a la vida.

sw.L: Naye alikufa kwa ajili ya wote, ili walio hai wasiishi tena kwa ajili yao wenyewe, bali kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ambaye kwa ajili yao alikufa na kufufuliwa.
sw.B: Alikufa kwa ajili ya wote, ili wale walio hai wasiishi tena kwa ajili yao wenyewe, bali kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} aliyekufa na kufufuliwa kwa ajili yao.
sw.R: Alikufa kwa ajili ya kila mtu ili watu walio hai wasiishi tena kwa kujipendeza wenyewe tu. Wataishi kwa ajili ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, aliyekufa kwa ajili yao na kufufuliwa.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chết thay cho mọi người, để những người đang sống không còn sống cho chính mình nữa, nhưng sống cho Đấng đã chết và đã được làm cho sống lại vì họ.
vi.B: Ngài đã chết thay cho mọi người, để những người đang sống không còn sống cho chính mình nữa, nhưng sống cho Đấng đã chết và đã được sống lại vì họ.
vi.R: Ngài đã chết cho mọi người, để những người đang sống không chỉ sống để làm vui lòng chính mình nữa. Họ sẽ sống cho {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, là Đấng đã chết cho họ và đã được sống lại.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 모든 사람을 위하여 죽으신 것은, 살아 있는 사람들이 더 이상 자기 자신을 위하여 살지 않고, 그들을 위하여 죽으셨다가 살리심을 받으신 분을 위하여 살게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 그분이 모든 사람을 위해 죽으신 것은, 살아 있는 사람들이 이제는 자기 자신을 위해 살지 않고, 그들을 위해 죽으시고 다시 살아나신 분을 위해 살게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.R: 그분은 모든 사람을 위해 죽으셨습니다. 그것은 살아 있는 사람들이 이제 자기 자신을 기쁘게 하려고만 살지 않게 하려는 것이었습니다. 그들은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 위해 살 것입니다. 그분은 그들을 위해 죽으셨고 다시 살아나셨습니다.

pt.L: E por todos {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} morreu, para que os que vivem não vivam mais para si mesmos, mas para aquele que por eles morreu e foi ressuscitado.
pt.B: Ele morreu por todos, para que os que vivem não vivam mais para si mesmos, mas para aquele que morreu e foi ressuscitado por eles.
pt.R: Ele morreu por todos, para que as pessoas que estão vivas não vivam mais só para agradar a si mesmas. Elas vão viver para {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}, que morreu por elas e foi ressuscitado.

am.L: ሕያዋን የሆኑትም ስለ እነርሱ ለሞተውና ለተነሣው እንጂ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ለራሳቸው እንዳይኖሩ ስለ ሁሉ ሞተ።
am.B: ሕያዋን የሆኑት ከእንግዲህ ስለ እነርሱ ለሞተውና ለተነሣው እንጂ ለራሳቸው እንዳይኖሩ ስለ ሁሉ ሞተ።
am.R: በሕይወት ያሉ ሰዎች ከእንግዲህ ራሳቸውን ለማስደሰት ብቻ እንዳይኖሩ እርሱ ለሁሉ ሞተ። ስለ እነርሱ ለሞተውና ከሞት ለተነሣው {{christos:ለክርስቶስ|ለመሲሑ}} ይኖራሉ።

hi.L: और वे सब के लिए मरे, ताकि जो जीवित हैं वे आगे को अपने लिए न जिएँ, पर उनके लिए जो उनके लिए मरे और जिलाए गए।
hi.B: वे सब के लिए मरे, ताकि जो जीवित हैं वे अब अपने लिए न जिएँ, बल्कि उनके लिए जिएँ जो उनके लिए मरे और जिलाए गए।
hi.R: वे सब के लिए मरे, ताकि जो लोग जीवित हैं वे अब केवल अपने आप को प्रसन्न करने के लिए न जिएँ। वे मसीह के लिए जिएँगे, जो उनके लिए मरे और फिर से जिलाए गए।

ru.L: И за всех {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} умер, чтобы живущие больше не для себя жили, но для умершего за них и воскресшего.
ru.B: Он умер за всех, чтобы те, кто живёт, жили уже не ради себя, а ради того, кто за них умер и воскрес.
ru.R: Он умер за всех, чтобы люди, которые живы, больше не жили только для себя. Они будут жить для {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}, который умер за них и был возвращён к жизни.

uk.L: І за всіх {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} помер, щоб живі вже не для себе жили, а для того, хто за них помер і воскрес.
uk.B: Він помер за всіх, щоб ті, хто живе, уже не жили для себе, а для того, хто помер і воскрес за них.
uk.R: Він помер за всіх, щоб люди, які живуть, більше не жили тільки собі на втіху. Вони житимуть для {{christos:Христа|Месії}}, який помер за них і воскрес до життя.

ja.L: そして、すべての人のために死なれたのは、生きている者たちが、もはや自分自身のために生きるのではなく、彼らのために死んでよみがえらされた方のために生きるためです。
ja.B: この方がすべての人のために死なれたのは、生きている人たちが、もはや自分のために生きるのではなく、自分たちのために死んでよみがえらされた方のために生きるようになるためです。
ja.R: {{christos:キリスト|メシア}}がすべての人のために死なれたのは、生きている人たちが、もう自分を喜ばせるためだけに生きるのではなく、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}のために生きるようになるためです。{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}は、その人たちのために死に、そして生き返らされた方なのです。

decisions.choice: so that: the purpose of Christ's death is a new direction for life
decisions.reason: ἵνα states purpose. Christ died not only so that people would be forgiven but so that their lives would belong to him.

decisions.choice: the living: those now alive, who have died with Christ and live by him
decisions.reason: οἱ ζῶντες stands against "all died" in verse 14: those included in Christ's death now live a new life, which is the new creation of verse 17.

decisions.choice: on their behalf goes with both verbs: he died and was raised for them
alternatives: for them goes only with died
decisions.reason: ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν stands before both participles. Paul says the same in Romans 4:25: he was handed over for our trespasses and raised for our justification. The passive ἐγερθέντι implies that God raised him.

decisions.choice: Christ
decisions.reason: Readable names Christ where the Greek says "the one".

decisions.choice: on behalf of all he died (L); He died on behalf of all (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek order, which puts "on behalf of all" first to link with verse 14.

decisions.choice: resucitó
decisions.reason: The Greek is passive, "was raised" by God. Spanish commonly uses "resucitó" for this, and the passive "fue resucitado" sounds stiff; the meaning is unchanged, and 4:14 already says that God raised Jesus.

source.text: Ὥστε ἡμεῖς ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν οὐδένα οἴδαμεν κατὰ σάρκα· εἰ καὶ ἐγνώκαμεν κατὰ σάρκα Χριστόν, ἀλλὰ νῦν οὐκέτι γινώσκομεν.

records.literal_gloss: So that we from the now no one know according to flesh; if even we have known according to flesh Christ, yet now no longer we know [him].

en.L: So from now on we know no one according to [the] flesh; even if we have known {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} according to [the] flesh, yet now we no longer know [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} so].
en.B: So from now on we look at no one by merely human standards. Even if we once knew {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} by those standards, that is not how we know {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} now.
en.R: So from now on we do not judge anyone by the way things look to human eyes. At one time we thought about {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} in that way too, but we do not think of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} like that anymore.

fr.L: Ainsi nous, désormais, nous ne connaissons personne selon la chair ; même si nous avons connu le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} selon la chair, maintenant pourtant nous ne [{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}] connaissons plus [ainsi].
fr.B: Ainsi, désormais, nous ne regardons plus personne selon des critères purement humains. Même si nous avons autrefois connu le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} de cette manière, ce n’est plus ainsi que nous {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} connaissons maintenant.
fr.R: Alors, maintenant, nous ne jugeons plus personne d’après ce que voient les yeux humains. Autrefois, nous pensions aussi au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} de cette façon, mais nous ne pensons plus à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} comme cela.

es.L: De modo que nosotros, desde ahora, no conocemos a nadie según [la] carne; aunque hayamos conocido {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} según [la] carne, ahora ya no [{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} conocemos así].
es.B: Así que, desde ahora, no miramos a nadie con criterios meramente humanos. Aunque antes conocimos {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} con esos criterios, ya no {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} conocemos así.
es.R: Así que, desde ahora, no juzgamos a nadie por cómo se ven las cosas a ojos humanos. Antes pensábamos así también acerca {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, pero ya no pensamos así de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo sisi tangu sasa hatumjui mtu yeyote kwa kufuata mwili; hata ikiwa tumemjua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kwa kufuata mwili, lakini sasa hatumjui tena [hivyo].
sw.B: Kwa hiyo tangu sasa hatumtazami mtu yeyote kwa vipimo vya kibinadamu tu. Hata kama hapo kwanza tulimjua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kwa vipimo hivyo, sasa hatumjui hivyo tena.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo tangu sasa hatumhukumu mtu yeyote kwa jinsi mambo yanavyoonekana kwa macho ya kibinadamu. Wakati fulani tulimfikiria {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kwa namna hiyo pia, lakini sasa hatumfikirii hivyo tena.

vi.L: Vậy từ nay chúng tôi không biết ai theo xác thịt; dù chúng tôi đã từng biết {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} theo xác thịt, nhưng nay chúng tôi không còn biết [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như thế] nữa.
vi.B: Vậy, từ nay chúng tôi không nhìn ai theo tiêu chuẩn thuần túy con người. Dù trước kia chúng tôi đã từng biết {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} theo tiêu chuẩn ấy, thì nay chúng tôi không còn biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như vậy nữa.
vi.R: Vậy từ nay chúng tôi không đánh giá ai theo cách con người nhìn bên ngoài. Có một thời chúng tôi cũng đã nghĩ về {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} theo cách ấy, nhưng nay chúng tôi không còn nghĩ về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như thế nữa.

ko.L: 그러므로 우리는 이제부터 아무도 육신을 따라 알지 않습니다. 비록 우리가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}도 육신을 따라 알았을지라도, 이제는 더 이상 그렇게 알지 않습니다.
ko.B: 그래서 우리는 이제부터 아무도 사람의 기준으로 보지 않습니다. 우리가 한때 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 그런 기준으로 알았다 하더라도, 이제는 그분을 그렇게 알지 않습니다.
ko.R: 그래서 이제부터 우리는 아무도 사람의 눈에 보이는 대로 판단하지 않습니다. 한때 우리는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}에 대해서도 그런 식으로 생각했습니다. 그러나 이제는 더 이상 그분을 그렇게 생각하지 않습니다.

pt.L: De modo que nós, de agora em diante, não conhecemos ninguém segundo [a] carne; ainda que tenhamos conhecido {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} segundo [a] carne, agora já não [{{deity_pronoun:o|O}}] conhecemos [assim].
pt.B: Por isso, de agora em diante, não olhamos para ninguém segundo critérios meramente humanos. Ainda que um dia tenhamos conhecido {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} segundo esses critérios, não é assim que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} conhecemos agora.
pt.R: Por isso, de agora em diante, não julgamos ninguém pelo que os olhos humanos veem. Houve um tempo em que também pensávamos assim a respeito {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, mas não pensamos mais assim a respeito {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.

am.L: ስለዚህ እኛ ከአሁን ጀምሮ ማንንም እንደ ሥጋ አናውቅም፤ {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሑን}} እንደ ሥጋ አውቀነው እንኳ ብንሆን፣ አሁን ግን [እንደዚያ] አናውቀውም።
am.B: ስለዚህ ከአሁን ጀምሮ ማንንም በሰው መለኪያ ብቻ አንመለከትም። {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሑን}} በዚያ መለኪያ አውቀነው የነበርን ብንሆን እንኳ፣ አሁን ግን እንደዚያ አናውቀውም።
am.R: ስለዚህ ከአሁን ጀምሮ ማንንም ሰው በሰው ዓይን በሚታየው አንፈርድም። በአንድ ወቅት ስለ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} እንደዚያ እናስብ ነበር፤ አሁን ግን ስለ እርሱ እንደዚያ አናስብም።

hi.L: सो अब से हम किसी को शरीर के अनुसार नहीं जानते; यद्यपि हमने मसीह को भी शरीर के अनुसार जाना था, तो भी अब [उन्हें ऐसे] नहीं जानते।
hi.B: इसलिए अब से हम किसी को केवल मानवीय मापदंडों से नहीं देखते। यद्यपि हमने कभी मसीह को भी इन्हीं मापदंडों से जाना था, अब हम उन्हें इस तरह नहीं जानते।
hi.R: इसलिए अब से हम किसी को इंसानी नज़र से नहीं परखते। एक समय हम मसीह के बारे में भी ऐसे ही सोचते थे, पर अब हम उनके बारे में ऐसा नहीं सोचते।

ru.L: Так что мы отныне никого не знаем по плоти; если же и знали {{christos:Христа|Мессию}} по плоти, то теперь уже не знаем [{{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} так].
ru.B: Поэтому отныне мы ни на кого не смотрим по чисто человеческим меркам. Даже если когда-то мы и знали {{christos:Христа|Мессию}} по этим меркам, теперь мы знаем {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} не так.
ru.R: Поэтому теперь мы ни о ком не судим по тому, как всё выглядит на человеческий взгляд. Когда-то мы так думали и о {{christos:Христе|Мессии}}, но теперь мы так о {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} больше не думаем.

uk.L: Тож відтепер ми нікого не знаємо за тілом; якщо ж ми й знали {{christos:Христа|Месію}} за тілом, то тепер уже не знаємо [{{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} так].
uk.B: Тож відтепер ми ні на кого не дивимося за суто людськими мірками. Навіть якщо колись ми знали {{christos:Христа|Месію}} за цими мірками, то тепер ми знаємо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} не так.
uk.R: Тож відтепер ми не судимо нікого за тим, як усе виглядає на людське око. Колись ми так само думали і про {{christos:Христа|Месію}}, але тепер ми більше так про {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} не думаємо.

ja.L: それで、わたしたちは今から後、だれをも肉によって知ることはしません。たとえ、わたしたちが{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}を肉によって知っていたとしても、今はもはや[そのようには]知りません。
ja.B: ですから、わたしたちは今からは、だれのことも、ただ人間的な基準で見ることはしません。かつては{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}をそのような基準で知っていたとしても、今はもう、そのようには知っていません。
ja.R: ですから、わたしたちは今から、だれのことも、人の目にどう見えるかで判断しません。かつては、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}のことも、そのように考えていました。でも今は、もうそのようには考えていません。

decisions.choice: so: what follows from verses 14-15
decisions.reason: Ὥστε draws the conclusion: since all have died with Christ and live for him, Paul no longer sees anyone in the old way.

decisions.choice: according to the flesh: by merely human standards, the way people judge without God
decisions.reason: κατὰ σάρκα describes a way of knowing, as in 1:17 and 10:2, where Paul's critics say he lives "according to the flesh". It is judging by outward things, the "face" of verse 12.

decisions.choice: the phrase goes with the verb: knowing Christ in a merely human way, not "Christ in the flesh"
alternatives: knowing the earthly Jesus personally, which Paul now sets aside
decisions.reason: The phrase stands between the verb and Χριστόν, and in the first half of the verse it plainly goes with "know". So Paul is not dismissing the earthly life of Jesus; he is saying he once judged Christ by human standards. As a persecutor he took the crucified Jesus to be accursed (Galatians 1:13; 3:13; 1 Corinthians 1:23). The words do not say whether Paul ever saw Jesus during his earthly life.

decisions.choice: even if: granting that it was so
decisions.reason: εἰ καὶ with the perfect ἐγνώκαμεν grants something true of Paul's past. "We" is Paul here, who once persecuted the church.

decisions.choice: by merely human standards (B); by the way things look to human eyes (R)
alternatives: from a worldly point of view
decisions.reason: As in 1:17, Literal keeps "flesh", while Balanced and Readable give the sense (m2). "Worldly" is avoided because it would blur the word with "world".

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: kwa kufuata mwili (L); kwa vipimo vya kibinadamu tu (B); kwa macho ya kibinadamu (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:17: Literal keeps "mwili" (flesh); Balanced and Readable say what it means here, merely human standards. The object "him" is inside the verbs ("hatumjui", "hatumfikirii"), so Swahili has no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: "theo xác thịt" (L); "theo tiêu chuẩn thuần túy con người" (B), going with the verb
alternatives: "Đấng Christ theo xác thịt" read as Christ's earthly life
decisions.reason: The phrase goes with "know", not with "Christ" (m3): a merely human way of knowing. Literal keeps "xác thịt" for sarx; its word order puts the phrase after the verb, as the Greek does.

decisions.choice: "육신을 따라" (L); "사람의 기준으로" (B); "사람의 눈에 보이는 대로" (R), with the phrase attached to the verb
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the phrase with the verb, a merely human way of knowing, not "Christ in the flesh"; Korean places it with the verb at every level.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} (with the article in the alternative)
decisions.reason: Portuguese needs the article with "Messias" as an object ("conhecido o Messias"), so the alternative carries it, where the English Literal has none.

decisions.choice: "शरीर के अनुसार" (L); "मानवीय मापदंडों से" (B); "इंसानी नज़र से" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:17: Literal keeps flesh (sarx) as "शरीर", Balanced and Readable give the sense (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: по плоти (L); по чисто человеческим меркам (B)
decisions.reason: As in 1:17, Literal keeps "плоть", the settled word for sarx, while Balanced and Readable give the sense (m2).

decisions.choice: за тілом (L); за суто людськими мірками (B); як усе виглядає на людське око (R)
decisions.reason: As the corinthians terms note sets for sarx: Literal keeps "тіло" as Romans does, Balanced says "by merely human standards" (m2). The phrase goes with the verb, not with Christ (m3).

decisions.choice: "肉によって" (L); "人間的な基準で" (B); "人の目にどう見えるかで" (R)
alternatives: "罪に傾く人間の性質" (R), the style guide's word for flesh in the moral sense
decisions.reason: Here flesh is a way of judging, by merely human standards (m2), not the moral sense, so Readable does not use the style guide's moral-sense phrase.

source.text: ὥστε εἴ τις ἐν Χριστῷ, καινὴ κτίσις· τὰ ἀρχαῖα παρῆλθεν, ἰδοὺ γέγονεν καινά·

records.literal_gloss: So that if anyone [is] in Christ, new creation; the old things passed away, look, have come to be new [things];

en.L: So if anyone [is] in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, [there is] a new creation; the old things have passed away; look, new things have come into being.
en.B: So if anyone is in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, that person is part of a new creation. The old things have gone, and look, new things have come into being.
en.R: So if anyone is joined to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, God has made a new start, a new creation, and that person belongs to it. The old things are gone. Look, something new has begun!

fr.L: Ainsi, si quelqu’un [est] {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, [il y a] une création nouvelle ; les choses anciennes sont passées ; voici, des choses nouvelles sont advenues.
fr.B: Ainsi, si quelqu’un est {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, il fait partie d’une création nouvelle. Les choses anciennes sont passées, et voici que des choses nouvelles sont apparues.
fr.R: Alors, si quelqu’un est uni au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, Dieu a fait un nouveau départ, une création nouvelle, et cette personne en fait partie. Les choses anciennes ont disparu. Regardez, quelque chose de nouveau a commencé !

es.L: De modo que, si alguno [está] en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, [hay] una nueva creación; las cosas viejas pasaron; {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, han llegado a ser cosas nuevas.
es.B: Así que, si alguien está en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, es parte de una nueva creación. Lo viejo ha pasado, y {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}: lo nuevo ha llegado.
es.R: Así que, si alguien está unido {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}, Dios ha hecho un nuevo comienzo, una nueva creación, y esa persona pertenece a ella. Lo viejo ya pasó. {{plural_you:¡Miren|¡Mirad}}, algo nuevo ha comenzado!

sw.L: Kwa hiyo ikiwa mtu yeyote [yuko] katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, [kuna] uumbaji mpya; mambo ya kale yamepita; tazama, mambo mapya yamekuja.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo ikiwa mtu yeyote yuko katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, mtu huyo ni sehemu ya uumbaji mpya. Mambo ya kale yamepita, na tazama, mambo mapya yamekuja.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo ikiwa mtu ameunganishwa na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Mungu ameanza upya, ameumba kitu kipya, na mtu huyo ni sehemu yake. Mambo ya zamani yamepita. Tazama, jambo jipya limeanza!

vi.L: Vậy nếu ai ở trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, [thì có] một cuộc tạo dựng mới; những điều cũ đã qua đi; kìa, những điều mới đã đến.
vi.B: Vậy nếu ai ở trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, thì người ấy thuộc về một cuộc tạo dựng mới. Những điều cũ đã qua đi, và kìa, những điều mới đã đến.
vi.R: Vậy nếu ai được gắn bó với {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, thì Đức Chúa Trời đã làm một khởi đầu mới, một cuộc tạo dựng mới, và người ấy thuộc về cuộc tạo dựng ấy. Những điều cũ đã qua rồi. Hãy xem, một điều mới đã bắt đầu!

ko.L: 그러므로 누구든지 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에 있으면 새로운 창조가 [있습니다]. 옛것들은 지나갔습니다. 보십시오, 새것들이 생겨났습니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 누구든지 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에 있으면, 그 사람은 새로운 창조에 속한 사람입니다. 옛것은 지나갔습니다. 보십시오, 새것이 생겨났습니다.
ko.R: 그러니 누구든지 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 하나가 되면, 하나님께서 새롭게 시작하신 새 창조에 그 사람도 속하게 됩니다. 옛것은 사라졌습니다. 보십시오, 새로운 것이 시작되었습니다!

pt.L: De modo que, se alguém [está] {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}, [há] nova criação; as coisas antigas passaram; eis que coisas novas vieram a existir.
pt.B: Portanto, se alguém está {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}, essa pessoa faz parte de uma nova criação. As coisas antigas se foram, e vejam: coisas novas vieram a existir.
pt.R: Por isso, se alguém está unido {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}}, Deus fez um novo começo, uma nova criação, e essa pessoa pertence a ela. As coisas antigas acabaram. Vejam: algo novo começou!

am.L: ስለዚህ ማንም {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ቢሆን፣ አዲስ ፍጥረት [አለ]፤ አሮጌዎቹ ነገሮች አልፈዋል፤ እነሆ፣ አዳዲስ ሆነዋል።
am.B: ስለዚህ ማንም {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ቢሆን፣ ያ ሰው የአዲሱ ፍጥረት አካል ነው። አሮጌዎቹ ነገሮች አልፈዋል፤ ተመልከቱ፣ አዳዲስ ነገሮች ሆነዋል።
am.R: ስለዚህ ማንም {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሑ}} ጋር አንድ ቢሆን፣ እግዚአብሔር አዲስ ጅማሬ፣ አዲስ ፍጥረት አድርጓል፤ ያም ሰው የዚሁ ነው። አሮጌዎቹ ነገሮች አልፈዋል። ተመልከቱ፣ አዲስ ነገር ጀምሯል!

hi.L: सो यदि कोई मसीह में [है], [तो] नई सृष्टि [है]; पुरानी बातें बीत गईं, देखो, नई बातें हो गई हैं।
hi.B: इसलिए यदि कोई मसीह में है, तो वह नई सृष्टि का भाग है। पुरानी बातें बीत गई हैं, और देखो, नई बातें आ गई हैं।
hi.R: इसलिए यदि कोई मसीह से जुड़ा है, तो परमेश्वर ने एक नई शुरुआत की है, एक नई सृष्टि, और वह व्यक्ति उसका हिस्सा है। पुरानी बातें चली गईं। देखो, कुछ नया शुरू हो गया है!

ru.L: Итак, если кто {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}}, [он] — новое творение; древнее прошло, вот, стало новое.
ru.B: Итак, если кто-то {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}}, этот человек — часть нового творения. Старое ушло, и вот, появилось новое.
ru.R: Итак, если кто-то соединён с {{christos:Христом|Мессией}}, Бог сделал новое начало, новое творение, и этот человек принадлежит ему. Старое прошло. Посмотрите, началось нечто новое!

uk.L: Отже, якщо хтось {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}}, [то це] нове творіння; давнє минуло, ось стало нове.
uk.B: Тож якщо хтось {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}}, ця людина — частина нового творіння. Давнє минуло, і ось постало нове.
uk.R: Тож якщо хтось зʼєднаний із {{christos:Христом|Месією}}, Бог почав усе наново, створив нове творіння, і ця людина належить до нього. Старе минуло. Дивіться, почалося щось нове!

ja.L: それで、もしだれかが{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}にあるなら、[その人は]新しく造られた者です。古いものは過ぎ去りました。見なさい、新しいものが生じています。
ja.B: ですから、だれでも{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}に結ばれているなら、その人は新しく造られた者、神が始められた新しい創造に加えられた者です。古いものは過ぎ去りました。見なさい、新しいものが生まれています。
ja.R: ですから、だれでも{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}と一つにされているなら、その人は新しく造られた者です。神は新しい世界を造り始められ、その人はその一部となっているのです。古いものは、もう過ぎ去りました。見てください。新しいことが始まったのです。

decisions.choice: new creation: the new creation God has begun is there, and the person in Christ is part of it
alternatives: he or she is a new creation, a changed individual only
there is a new world, with no stress on the person
decisions.reason: The clause has no verb or subject: "if anyone in Christ, new creation". It can be filled out as "that person is a new creation" or "there is a new creation". In Galatians 6:15 new creation is the new order God brings, and the words that follow here ("the old things have passed away") speak of more than one person. The person in Christ does become new, but as part of what God is doing for the whole creation.

decisions.choice: new creation, old things passed, new things come: the promises of Isaiah
alternatives: Paul's own picture with no Old Testament background
decisions.reason: Isaiah 43:18-19 tells God's people not to remember the former things, because God is doing a new thing; Isaiah 65:17 promises new heavens and a new earth, when the former things will not be remembered. The Greek Old Testament of Isaiah 43:18-19 uses words close to ἀρχαῖα ("old things") and καινά ("new"). Paul says the new age has begun in Christ.

decisions.choice: in Christ: joined to Christ, sharing his death and life
decisions.reason: ἐν Χριστῷ describes union with Christ, as in verses 14-15: those who died with him live for him. It recalls 4:6, where the God of creation has shone in their hearts.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "new things have come into being"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts read "all things" after the verb, which gives the familiar "all things have become new". The SBLGNT follows the older manuscripts, which lack it; the words may come from Revelation 21:5. Reviewers must check the apparatus.

decisions.choice: have passed away, have come into being: a change already made, whose effects last
decisions.reason: παρῆλθεν is aorist: the old order has gone. γέγονεν is perfect: the new has come and remains. Paul still waits for the resurrection body (verses 1-5), but the new creation has already begun.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: look
decisions.reason: "Behold" is old-fashioned English; "look" keeps the call to see.

decisions.choice: that person is part of a new creation (B); God has made a new start, a new creation, and that person belongs to it (R)
decisions.reason: Both levels fill out the clause with no verb in the way chosen in m1, which is uncertain; the footnote gives the other reading.

decisions.choice: joined to Christ
decisions.reason: Readable says what "in Christ" means (m3).

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}
decisions.reason: Paul is speaking to the Corinthians, so "look" is plural and takes the ustedes/vosotros setting, as the guide gives for "idou" said to a group; "he aquí" is old-fashioned.

decisions.choice: uumbaji mpya
decisions.reason: As in Galatians 6:15: "kiumbe kipya" (a new creature) would name only the person made new, while the meaning decision reads this as the new creation God has begun, of which the person is part. "Uumbaji mpya" says that.

decisions.choice: "một cuộc tạo dựng mới" at every level for kaine ktisis, with "người ấy thuộc về" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Một cuộc tạo dựng mới" is the phrase of the Vietnamese Galatians 6:15 for the same Greek words. The Greek has no verb (m1); Literal brackets "[thì có]", leaving open whether the person is a new creation or belongs to the one God has begun, and Balanced and Readable take the reading of m1, as the English does. "Tạo vật mới" would settle it the other way.

decisions.choice: "kìa" (L), "kìa" (B), "Hãy xem" (R) for idou
decisions.reason: As in 1 Corinthians 15:51 at Literal; here Balanced keeps it too, as the English keeps "look".

decisions.choice: "새로운 창조" (L, B); "새 창조" (R), as in Galatians 6:15
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the verbless phrase as the new creation God has begun, of which the person in Christ is part, uncertain and footnoted; "새로운 창조" keeps the larger sense of Galatians 6:15, where "새로운 피조물" would narrow it to the person.

decisions.choice: "보십시오" for "look" at every level
decisions.reason: The plain call to attention, in the polite style of the letter.

decisions.choice: вот (L, B); Посмотрите (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "вот" for idou, as the style guide settles; Balanced keeps it too, as the English keeps "look", and Readable makes it a call to see.

decisions.choice: этот человек — часть нового творения (B); Бог сделал новое начало ... и этот человек принадлежит ему (R)
decisions.reason: Both levels fill out the verbless clause in the way chosen in m1, as the English does; the reading is uncertain.

decisions.choice: "新しく造られた者" (all levels), with "神が始められた新しい創造" (B) and "神は新しい世界を造り始められ" (R)
decisions.reason: The term is settled for the letter as "新しく造られた者". Since the Greek speaks of the new creation God has begun, of which the person is part (m1), Balanced and Readable add that wider sense, as the English Balanced and Readable do.

source.text: τὰ δὲ πάντα ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ καταλλάξαντος ἡμᾶς ἑαυτῷ διὰ Χριστοῦ καὶ δόντος ἡμῖν τὴν διακονίαν τῆς καταλλαγῆς, ὡς ὅτι θεὸς ἦν ἐν Χριστῷ κόσμον καταλλάσσων ἑαυτῷ, μὴ λογιζόμενος αὐτοῖς τὰ παραπτώματα αὐτῶν, καὶ θέμενος ἐν ἡμῖν τὸν λόγον τῆς καταλλαγῆς.

records.literal_gloss: The and all things [are] from the God the [one] having reconciled us to himself through Christ and having given to us the ministry of the reconciliation, \v 19 as that God was in Christ world reconciling to himself, not reckoning to them the trespasses of them, and having placed in us the word of the reconciliation.

en.L: And all things [are] from God, who reconciled us to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} through {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} and gave us the ministry of reconciliation, \v 19 namely, that God was in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} reconciling [the] world to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having placed in us the word of reconciliation.
en.B: And all of it is God's doing. Through {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has reconciled us to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given us the ministry of reconciliation. \v 19 For it was God who, in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, was at work reconciling the world to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}. He did not hold their trespasses against them, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has put the word of reconciliation in our keeping.
en.R: All of this is God's work. Through {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, God has brought us back to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given us the work of bringing others back to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} too. \v 19 This is the message: in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, God was bringing the people of the world back to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}. He was not keeping a record of their sins against them. And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has trusted us with this message that people can be brought back to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Et tout [vient] de Dieu, qui nous a réconciliés avec {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} par le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} et nous a donné le ministère de la réconciliation, \v 19 à savoir que Dieu était {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, réconciliant le monde avec {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}, ne leur comptant pas leurs fautes, et ayant mis en nous la parole de la réconciliation.
fr.B: Et tout cela est l’œuvre de Dieu. Par le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a réconciliés avec {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a confié le ministère de la réconciliation. \v 19 Car c’est Dieu qui, {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, était à l’œuvre pour réconcilier le monde avec {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}. Il n’a pas retenu leurs fautes contre eux, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a confié la parole de la réconciliation.
fr.R: Tout cela, c’est l’œuvre de Dieu. Par le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, Dieu nous a ramenés à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a donné le travail de ramener les autres à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, eux aussi. \v 19 Voici le message : {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, Dieu ramenait les gens du monde à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Il ne gardait pas la liste de leurs péchés contre eux. Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a confié ce message : les gens peuvent être ramenés à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

es.L: Y todas las cosas [son] de Dios, que nos reconcilió consigo por medio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} y nos dio el ministerio de la reconciliación, \v 19 a saber, que Dios estaba en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} reconciliando [al] mundo consigo, no tomándoles en cuenta sus transgresiones, y habiendo puesto en nosotros la palabra de la reconciliación.
es.B: Y todo esto es obra de Dios. Por medio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} nos ha reconciliado consigo, y nos ha dado el ministerio de la reconciliación. \v 19 Porque era Dios quien, en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, estaba reconciliando al mundo consigo. No les tomó en cuenta sus transgresiones, y ha puesto en nuestras manos la palabra de la reconciliación.
es.R: Todo esto es obra de Dios. Por medio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, Dios nos ha traído de vuelta a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}}, y nos ha dado el trabajo de traer también a otros de vuelta a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \v 19 Este es el mensaje: en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, Dios estaba trayendo de vuelta a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} a la gente del mundo. No llevaba la cuenta de sus pecados contra ellos. Y nos ha confiado este mensaje: que la gente puede volver a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

sw.L: Na mambo yote [ni] kutoka kwa Mungu, aliyetupatanisha {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} kupitia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, na kutupa huduma ya upatanisho, \v 19 yaani, kwamba Mungu alikuwa katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} akiupatanisha ulimwengu {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, bila kuwahesabia makosa yao, akiwa ameweka kwetu neno la upatanisho.
sw.B: Na haya yote ni kazi ya Mungu. Kupitia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ametupatanisha {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ametupa huduma ya upatanisho. \v 19 Kwa maana ni Mungu aliyekuwa akitenda kazi katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, akiupatanisha ulimwengu {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}. Hakuwahesabia watu makosa yao, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ametukabidhi neno la upatanisho.
sw.R: Haya yote ni kazi ya Mungu. Kupitia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Mungu ameturudisha {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ametupa kazi ya kuwarudisha wengine {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} pia. \v 19 Ujumbe ni huu: katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Mungu alikuwa akiwarudisha watu wa ulimwengu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. Hakuwa akiwahesabia dhambi zao. Naye ametukabidhi ujumbe huu, kwamba watu wanaweza kurudishwa {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.

vi.L: Mọi điều ấy [đều] từ Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng đã hòa giải chúng tôi với chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} qua {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} và đã giao cho chúng tôi chức vụ hòa giải, \v 19 ấy là Đức Chúa Trời đã ở trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} để hòa giải thế gian với chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, không kể những vi phạm của họ cho họ, và đã đặt nơi chúng tôi lời hòa giải.
vi.B: Tất cả những điều ấy đều là công việc của Đức Chúa Trời. Qua {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hòa giải chúng tôi với chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giao cho chúng tôi chức vụ hòa giải. \v 19 Vì chính Đức Chúa Trời, trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, đã hành động để hòa giải thế gian với chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài không kể những vi phạm của họ để buộc tội họ, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giao cho chúng tôi lời hòa giải.
vi.R: Tất cả những điều này là công việc của Đức Chúa Trời. Qua {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, Đức Chúa Trời đã đem chúng tôi trở về với chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giao cho chúng tôi công việc đem người khác trở về với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nữa. \v 19 Đây là sứ điệp: trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, Đức Chúa Trời đã đem người của thế gian trở về với chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài không ghi sổ tội lỗi của họ để buộc tội họ. Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giao phó cho chúng tôi sứ điệp này, là người ta có thể được đem trở về với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 이 모든 것은 하나님께로부터 [나옵니다]. 그분은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통하여 우리를 자신과 화해시키시고, 우리에게 화해의 직분을 주셨습니다. \v 19 곧 하나님께서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 세상을 자신과 화해시키시며, 그들의 범죄를 그들에게 돌리지 않으시고, 화해의 말씀을 우리에게 맡기셨다는 것입니다.
ko.B: 이 모든 것은 하나님께서 하신 일입니다. 하나님께서는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통해 우리를 자신과 화해시키시고, 우리에게 화해의 직분을 주셨습니다. \v 19 하나님께서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 세상을 자신과 화해시키고 계셨던 것입니다. 하나님께서는 그들의 범죄를 그들의 탓으로 돌리지 않으시고, 화해의 말씀을 우리에게 맡기셨습니다.
ko.R: 이 모든 것은 하나님께서 하신 일입니다. 하나님께서는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통해 우리를 하나님께로 다시 돌아오게 하셨습니다. 그리고 다른 사람들도 하나님께로 다시 돌아오게 하는 일을 우리에게 맡기셨습니다. \v 19 그 소식은 이것입니다. 하나님께서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 세상 사람들을 하나님께로 다시 돌아오게 하고 계셨습니다. 하나님께서는 그들의 죄를 장부에 적어 두지 않으셨습니다. 그리고 사람들이 하나님께로 돌아올 수 있다는 이 소식을 우리에게 맡기셨습니다.

pt.L: E todas as coisas [vêm] de Deus, que nos reconciliou {{deity_pronoun:consigo mesmo|Consigo mesmo}} por meio {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} e nos deu o ministério da reconciliação, \v 19 a saber, que Deus estava {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} reconciliando [o] mundo {{deity_pronoun:consigo mesmo|Consigo mesmo}}, não lhes atribuindo as suas transgressões, e tendo posto em nós a palavra da reconciliação.
pt.B: E tudo isso é obra de Deus. Por meio {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos reconciliou {{deity_pronoun:consigo mesmo|Consigo mesmo}} e nos deu o ministério da reconciliação. \v 19 Pois era Deus quem, {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}, estava agindo para reconciliar o mundo {{deity_pronoun:consigo mesmo|Consigo mesmo}}. Ele não levou em conta as transgressões das pessoas e nos confiou a palavra da reconciliação.
pt.R: Tudo isso é obra de Deus. Por meio {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, Deus nos trouxe de volta para {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}} e nos deu o trabalho de trazer outras pessoas de volta para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} também. \v 19 Esta é a mensagem: {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}, Deus estava trazendo as pessoas do mundo de volta para {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}}. Ele não ficava cobrando delas os seus pecados. E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos confiou esta mensagem: as pessoas podem ser trazidas de volta para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.

am.L: ሁሉም ደግሞ {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} በኩል ከራሱ ጋር ካስታረቀንና የማስታረቅን አገልግሎት ከሰጠን ከእግዚአብሔር ነው፤ \v 19 ይኸውም እግዚአብሔር በደላቸውን ሳይቆጥርባቸው {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ሆኖ ዓለምን ከራሱ ጋር ያስታርቅ ነበር፤ የማስታረቅንም ቃል በእኛ ውስጥ አኖረ።
am.B: ይህ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔር ሥራ ነው። እርሱ {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} በኩል ከራሱ ጋር አስታረቀን፤ የማስታረቅንም አገልግሎት ሰጠን። \v 19 ዓለምን {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ከራሱ ጋር ያስታርቅ የነበረው እግዚአብሔር ነውና። በደላቸውን አልቆጠረባቸውም፤ የማስታረቅንም ቃል በአደራ ሰጥቶናል።
am.R: ይህ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔር ሥራ ነው። እግዚአብሔር {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} በኩል ወደ ራሱ መለሰን፤ ሌሎችንም ወደ እርሱ የመመለስን ሥራ ሰጠን። \v 19 መልእክቱ ይህ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} የዓለምን ሰዎች ወደ ራሱ ይመልስ ነበር። ኃጢአታቸውን አልቆጠረባቸውም። ሰዎች ወደ እርሱ ሊመለሱ እንደሚችሉ የሚናገረውን ይህን መልእክት በአደራ ሰጥቶናል።

hi.L: और सब बातें परमेश्वर की ओर से हैं, जिन्होंने मसीह के द्वारा हमें अपने साथ मेल कराया, और मेल-मिलाप की सेवकाई हमें दी, \v 19 अर्थात् यह कि परमेश्वर मसीह में संसार का अपने साथ मेल करा रहे थे, उनके अपराधों को उनके विरुद्ध न गिनते हुए, और उन्होंने मेल-मिलाप का वचन हमें सौंप दिया है।
hi.B: और यह सब परमेश्वर का काम है। मसीह के द्वारा उन्होंने हमें अपने साथ मेल कराया है, और मेल-मिलाप की सेवकाई हमें दी है। \v 19 क्योंकि परमेश्वर ही थे जो मसीह में संसार का अपने साथ मेल कराने का काम कर रहे थे। उन्होंने लोगों के अपराधों का दोष उन पर नहीं लगाया, और मेल-मिलाप का वचन हमें सौंप दिया है।
hi.R: यह सब परमेश्वर का काम है। मसीह के द्वारा परमेश्वर हमें वापस अपने पास ले आए हैं, और उन्होंने हमें यह काम दिया है कि हम दूसरों को भी उनके पास वापस लाएँ। \v 19 संदेश यह है: मसीह में परमेश्वर संसार के लोगों को वापस अपने पास ला रहे थे। वे उनके पापों का हिसाब उनके विरुद्ध नहीं रख रहे थे। और उन्होंने हमें यह संदेश सौंपा है कि लोग उनके पास वापस लाए जा सकते हैं।

ru.L: Всё же от Бога, примирившего нас с собой через {{christos:Христа|Мессию}} и давшего нам служение примирения, \v 19 потому что Бог {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} примирял мир с собой, не вменяя им их преступлений, и вложил в нас слово примирения.
ru.B: И всё это — дело Бога. Через {{christos:Христа|Мессию}} {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} примирил нас с собой и дал нам служение примирения. \v 19 Ведь именно Бог {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} действовал, примиряя мир с собой. Он не ставил людям в вину их преступлений и доверил нам слово примирения.
ru.R: Всё это — дело Бога. Через {{christos:Христа|Мессию}} Бог вернул нас к себе, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} дал нам дело — возвращать к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}} и других. \v 19 Вот эта весть: {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Бог возвращал людей мира к себе. Он не вёл счёта их грехам против них. И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} доверил нам эту весть о том, что люди могут вернуться к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}}.

uk.L: А все від Бога, який примирив нас із собою через {{christos:Христа|Месію}} і дав нам служіння примирення, \v 19 бо Бог {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} примирював світ із собою, не зараховуючи їм їхніх провин, і поклав у нас слово примирення.
uk.B: І все це — Божа справа. Через {{christos:Христа|Месію}} {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} примирив нас із собою і дав нам служіння примирення. \v 19 Бо саме Бог {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} діяв, примирюючи світ із собою. Він не ставив людям у вину їхніх провин і довірив нам слово примирення.
uk.R: Усе це — Божа праця. Через {{christos:Христа|Месію}} Бог повернув нас до себе, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дав нам працю: повертати до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} й інших. \v 19 Ось ця звістка: {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Бог повертав людей світу до себе. Він не вів рахунку їхнім гріхам проти них. І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} довірив нам цю звістку, що люди можуть повернутися до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}.

ja.L: そして、すべては神から[出ています]。神は{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}を通してわたしたちをご自分と和解させ、和解の務めをわたしたちに与えてくださいました。\v 19 すなわち、神は{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}にあって世をご自分と和解させ、人々に彼らの過ちを負わせず、和解の言葉をわたしたちのうちに置かれたということです。
ja.B: これはすべて神から出ています。神は{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}を通してわたしたちをご自分と和解させ、和解の務めをわたしたちに与えてくださいました。\v 19 つまり、神は{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}において働き、世をご自分と和解させておられたのです。神は人々の過ちの責任を問わず、和解の言葉をわたしたちに託してくださいました。
ja.R: これはすべて、神がしてくださったことです。神は{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}を通して、わたしたちをご自分のもとに連れ戻してくださいました。そして、ほかの人たちを神のもとに連れ戻す働きを、わたしたちに任せてくださいました。\v 19 その知らせとは、こうです。神は{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}によって、世界の人々をご自分のもとに連れ戻そうとしておられました。神は、人々の罪を帳簿につけて責めることはなさいませんでした。そして、人は神のもとに連れ戻していただけるというこの知らせを、わたしたちに託してくださったのです。

decisions.choice: all this is from God: the new creation of verses 14-17 is God's work
alternatives: everything in the universe comes from God
decisions.reason: τὰ δὲ πάντα gathers up what has just been said: Christ's death for all, the new life, the new creation. All of it has its source in God, and the rest of the sentence says how.

decisions.choice: reconcile: to end hostility and restore a broken relationship; God is the one who reconciles, and people are reconciled to him
alternatives: God being reconciled to people, his anger appeased by them
decisions.reason: καταλλάξαντος and καταλλαγῆς are words for changing enemies into friends, used of a husband and wife making peace (1 Corinthians 7:11). In Paul, God always takes the first step: he reconciles people to himself (Romans 5:10-11; Colossians 1:20-22). The hostility to be overcome is on the human side, and the way it is overcome is Christ's death (verse 21).

decisions.choice: namely that: what follows explains the ministry and its message
decisions.reason: ὡς ὅτι is an unusual pairing. It most likely means "that is to say", introducing the content of the ministry of reconciliation.

decisions.choice: God was reconciling the world to himself in Christ: one act of God carried out through Christ
alternatives: "God was in Christ", a statement that God was present in Christ, followed by "reconciling the world"
decisions.reason: ἦν with καταλλάσσων most naturally forms one verb phrase, "was reconciling", and "in Christ" says how, as "through Christ" does in verse 18. The other reading, familiar from older translations, makes "God was in Christ" a statement on its own. That is true (Colossians 1:19; 2:9), but it is not the main point here.

decisions.choice: the world: humankind, the people God reconciles
decisions.reason: κόσμον has no article and is followed by the plural αὐτοῖς ("to them"), so the world here is people. Colossians 1:20 speaks of all things being reconciled; here the stress is on people whose trespasses are not counted.

decisions.choice: not counting their trespasses against them: like crossing debts off an account
decisions.reason: λογιζόμενος is a bookkeeping word, to enter in an account. Psalm 32:2, which Paul quotes in Romans 4:8, calls happy the person against whom the Lord does not count sin. Sin is not ignored: verse 21 says how God dealt with it.

decisions.choice: having placed in us: God has entrusted the message to them
alternatives: placed inside us as an inner experience
decisions.reason: θέμενος ἐν ἡμῖν means to put something in someone's charge. λόγον is the spoken message, which is how the ministry of verse 18 is carried out (verse 20).

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: reconcile, reconciliation
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep one English word family for the Greek family, so the repetition through verses 18-20 can be seen, as in Colossians 1:20-22.

decisions.choice: brought us back to him; bringing others back to him; bringing back; message that people can be brought back to him
decisions.reason: "Reconcile" is not an everyday word for many readers; as in Colossians 1:20-22, Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: trespasses (L, B); sins (R)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 2:13, Literal and Balanced say "trespasses" for this word, which pictures a false step; Readable uses the everyday word.

decisions.choice: it was God who, in Christ, was at work reconciling
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the stress on God as the one who acts and keeps "in Christ" with the verb, as m4 reads it.

decisions.choice: réconcilier, la réconciliation (L, B); ramener à lui (R) (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 1:20-22 and the English: Literal and Balanced keep one French family for the Greek family, so the repetition through verses 18-20 can be seen; Readable says what it means, God bringing people back to himself (m2).

decisions.choice: leurs fautes (L, B); leurs péchés (R)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 2:13 and Romans 5: "faute" is the French word used for a false step against God; Readable uses the everyday word, as the English does.

decisions.choice: reconciliar, reconciliación (L, B); traer de vuelta a sí mismo (R)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 1:20-22, Literal and Balanced keep "reconciliar"; Readable says what it means for people, that God brings them back to himself, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: consigo, with no span
decisions.reason: "Consigo" is one word joined to the preposition, like "conmigo" and "contigo", so by the Spanish guide it takes no deity_pronoun span; Readable uses the separate "a sí mismo", which does.

decisions.choice: kupatanisha, upatanisho (L, B); kurudisha kwake (R)
decisions.reason: "Kupatanisha" is the Swahili verb for making peace between parties who were at odds, and "upatanisho" its noun, as in Romans 5:10-11. Readable follows the English Readable and says "kurudisha kwake" (bring back to himself).

decisions.choice: bila kuwahesabia makosa yao
decisions.reason: "Kuhesabia" (to count to someone's account) is the bookkeeping verb Swahili Romans uses for God reckoning (Romans 4:8), which keeps the picture of crossing debts off an account (meaning decision). "Makosa" is the word for trespasses, as in Romans 11:11.

decisions.choice: "hòa giải ... với chính Ngài", "chức vụ hòa giải", "lời hòa giải" (L, B); "đem ... trở về với chính Ngài" (R) for katallasso and katallage (5:18-20)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice ("reconcile, reconciliation"; Readable "bring back to himself") in the words of the Vietnamese Colossians 1:20-22 and Romans 5:10-11. God is the one who reconciles and people are reconciled to him (m2), which the word order keeps.

decisions.choice: "những vi phạm" (L, B), "tội lỗi" (R) for paraptomata; "không kể ... cho họ" (L)
decisions.reason: The words of the Vietnamese Ephesians 2:1 and Colossians 2:13; "kể" is the bookkeeping verb of the Vietnamese Romans 4 (m6).

decisions.choice: "화해시키다", "화해" (L, B); "하나님께로 다시 돌아오게 하다" (R), here and in verse 20
decisions.reason: The words of Romans 5:10-11 and Colossians 1:20-22 for reconciliation (L, B); the meaning decision says God is the one who reconciles and people are reconciled to him, which "화해시키다" with God as subject keeps.
